# Tajaran
All information included in this document is licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0, and is taken from https://wiki.aurorastation.org/index.php?title=Tajaran with some modifications.
The Tajara (singular and plural: Tajara — Tah-jaw-rah) (adjective: Tajaran — Tah-jaw-ran) are a race of humanoids with felinoid traits: a semi-prehensile tail, a body covered in fur of varying shades, and padded, digitigrade feet. Tajaran history and society is deeply entrenched in the conflict between its caste system and ruling governments. The species currently finds itself in a cold war between three powers that control its homeworld, Adhomai.
# Biology
To the average human, the Tajara share many similarities with Earth's felines; from a purely scientific perspective this description is largely superficial. Unlike terrestrial felines, the Tajara are both omnivorous and bipedal. Their bodies are almost entirely covered in a thick coat of fur that is extremely good at insulating them from extreme cold. There are only a handful of areas where fur is not present — palms, soles, around the eyes, and a few orifices. Tajara have nictitating membranes that prevent snow blindness and keep their eyes moist against the wind.
Occasionally the fur around a Tajara's neck grows into a shaggy 'mane', giving them a lion-like look. Some Tajara tend towards monochromatic bodies while others have multicolor or even calico fur patterns; these depend heavily on parental genetics. A male Tajara is somewhere between 150 cm and 185 cm in height with a mean body mass between 65 kg and 100 kg. Females range between 150 cm and 175 cm with weight around 45-85 kg. A Tajaran fetus only takes six months to mature and children mature rapidly, reaching full growth by 15 or 16. Most Tajara retire at age 60.
## Ethnicities
Four races of Tajara exist: the Hharar, the Zhan-Khazan, the Njarir'Akhran, and the M'sai. Each race has a common role in society to which their biological inclinations make them more suited. Tajara heavily stereotype each other based on race, often a source of conflict.
### Hharar
The first Tajaran ethnicity humanity contacted, generally viewed as the 'typical Tajara'. Most often serve in governmental positions and as ambassadors to other races. Trend towards being the most intellectual of all Tajaran groups, with reduced physical prowess.
### Zhan-Khazan
The second most populous Tajaran ethnicity, considered the backbone of the Tajaran workforce. More physically intimidating: toned, muscular bodies, thicker fur coats, heavier body weight. Discriminated against and often regarded as less intelligent.
### M'sai
At one point the hunters for ancient Tajara — lithe, slender forms, light fur that hid them in blizzards. As Tajaran society advanced, M'sai found roles in law enforcement and military service. Loyal, sharp-sensed, and capable survivalists.
### Njarir'Akhran
The ethnic group that made up the majority of the plutocracy before the Great War. Easily identifiable by large ears, fluffy tails, luxurious fur, and slender, elegant features. As the most learned of all Tajaran ethnic groups, they boast high intelligence and a propensity for the arts and sciences.
# Species Traits
- [color=#1e90ff]Animal diet[/color]: Tajara are poisoned by theobromine, but can process uncooked animal protein.
- [color=#1e90ff]Cold Resistance[/color]: Tajara fare better against cold than humans and tolerate lower temperatures.
- [color=#1e90ff]Claws[/color]: Tajara unarmed attacks deal Slash damage instead of Blunt.
- [color=#1e90ff]Night Vision[/color]: Tajara can see in low light.
- [color=#1e90ff]Light Step[/color]: Thanks to their furred paw pads, Tajara can walk silently without shoes.
- [color=#ffa500]Heat Intolerance[/color]: Tajara take more Heat damage and burn more easily.
- [color=#ffa500]Light Build[/color]: Their small posture makes Tajara receive more Brute damage.
- [color=#ffa500]Sensitive Eyes[/color]: Tajara receive more damage from flashes.
